name: Jazzy Dice
tagline: Five dice, three rolls, one scorecard. Hold the right dice and go for JAZZ: five alike.

modes.name: Classic
modes.description: Fill all 13 boxes. Upper bonus of 35 for 63 or more in the top half.

modes.name: Quick
modes.description: 7 turns each, pick any 7 boxes. No upper bonus.

modes.name: Chat vs Streamer
modes.description: The streamer plays Gold, and chat votes on every Teal move. 7 turns each.
howTo: The streamer plays Gold. Chat plays Teal by voting: the most popular command wins each step.
Chat's best move: vote !keep with the dice to hold, e.g. !keep 135 holds dice 1, 3, 5 and rolls the rest.
!score, then vote for a box on the scorecard with !1–!13.
JAZZ = five alike: 50 points, every further one +100. 7 turns each, highest total wins.

commands.help: hold exactly dice 1, 3 and 5, then roll
pick a box: !1 … !13 on the scorecard
mods: switch mode in the lobby

howTo: On your turn: !roll. You get up to 3 rolls.
Hold dice with !1–!5 (or !keep 135 to hold dice 1, 3, 5 and roll), then !roll again.
!score, then pick a box on the scorecard with !1–!13. Each box is used once.
JAZZ = five alike: 50 points, every further one +100. Highest total wins.
